description: Post-checkout guest sends positive review + housekeeping FYI about missing sofa bed sheets. Must trigger cleaning alert and manual-reply escalation — not auto-reply with 'You're welcome'. Real production case (Amy, Apt 2, Jun 19 2026).
guestMessage: We had a lovely stay.  Happy to give 5 starts.  The only thing was that there were no sheets for the sofa bed.  Just an fyi for the next folks. Thanks for your hospitality! Best, amy
notes: Production incident: agent classified as SLEEPING_ARRANGEMENTS, shouldReply=true, cleaningIssueDetected=false, no escalation email. Root cause: CleaningIssueTool missed 'no sheets'; post-welcome thank-you false positive from prior check-in welcome in thread.
